questions.q: Why does the text encode node take so long for Music 3?
options: It runs a language model in a loop that generates audio codes frame by frame, 25 frames a second of music
questions.answer: It runs a language model in a loop that generates audio codes frame by frame, 25 frames a second of music
questions.why: encode_token_weights calls generate in ar.py, which samples codes in a loop and returns the hidden states as conditioning.

questions.q: What is the seconds output of MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode?
options: The length the model actually produced, which may be below max_duration
questions.answer: The length the model actually produced, which may be below max_duration
questions.why: It is conditioning[0][0].shape[1] / 25. The loop can stop early when it samples a stop token.

questions.q: You type a longer value into the empty latent than the seconds output. What happens to the extra part?
options: The DiT pads the condition with zeros, so that end has no guidance
The extra is removed before sampling
questions.answer: The DiT pads the condition with zeros, so that end has no guidance
questions.why: In MiniMaxMusic3DiT.forward, a condition shorter than x is padded with zeros.

questions.q: How are the 128 latent channels used by the decoder?
options: They fold into 64 for each stereo channel
All 128 go to one mono signal
128 is the number of mel bands
questions.answer: They fold into 64 for each stereo channel

questions.q: What happens to the tag [CHORUS] in the lyrics before tokenizing?
options: It goes on its own line, in lower case
questions.answer: It goes on its own line, in lower case
questions.why: normalize_lyrics splits on bracket tags, lowercases them and joins with line breaks. The lab prints [chorus].

questions.q: The graph has two CFG settings at 1.7. What do they act on?
options: cfg_scale on the code-generating loop, and cfg on the DiT's sampling
Both act on the language model
One is for each stereo channel
questions.answer: cfg_scale on the code-generating loop, and cfg on the DiT's sampling
questions.why: cfg_scale goes into generate, in ar.py, and KSampler's cfg guides the flow model.
